title: Function-Call Split
text: Provide junction for splitting function-call line, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Number of output ports} and {Output port layout} selects order of output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of output ports
params.values: Specify number of output ports 2 (default) | integer

params.name: Output port layout
params.values: Select order of output ports default (default) | reverse
